title: Rune Technologies Secures $99M Army IDIQ for TyrOS Logistics Software | Rune Technologies News
summary: Rune Technologies secured a $99 million Army contract to provide streamlined access to its TyrOS logistics software platform for military operations in contested environments.
body_markdown:
ExecutiveBiz covered Rune Technologies by Miles Jamison in a piece titled “Rune Technologies Secures $99M Army IDIQ for TyrOS Logistics Software.” Rune Technologies secured a $99 million Army contract to provide streamlined access to its TyrOS logistics software platform for military operations in contested environments.


Read the full article[here](https://www.executivebiz.com/articles/rune-technologies-army-tyros-software) .
